name: convert-old-project
comment: AE high-version opening low-version .aep — accept convert with Enter

name: resolve-fonts-missing
comment: Opening a project whose fonts aren't installed (e.g. the Booyah original) — accept substituted fonts with Enter so the open completes; irrelevant for shape-only comps

name: save-changes-on-quit
comment: Leftover from prev JSX missing app.quit — walk to 'Don't Save' button (locale-sensitive)

name: file-data-missing
comment: Mode 3 — fixture broken; press OK to let JSX catch + write .done(ERR)

name: ae-crashed
comment: AE hard-crash dialog 'After Effects 无法继续: 抱歉，After Effects 已崩溃。… (0 :: 42)' — the process is dead, .done can never appear. Crash action: press OK to release the corpse, exit 8 immediately. Gate harness warm-retries exit 8 once (cold-start crashes are transient); an identical second crash is a real reject — capture the .fail/ dump. ocrMatch carries ASCII anchors too (learn_ae from the support URL) because OCR mangles the CJK on this dialog ('Afer Effects 无 法...' observed 2026-06-11, AddMask gate). MUST stay BEFORE generic dismiss rules so the crash is classified, not blindly Enter'd.

name: preferences-damaged
comment: AE prefs file corrupted (usually a prior force-kill mid-shutdown — see incidents/ae-automation-occlusion-crashstate.md §2b). Enter accepts 'create new preferences file' and AE continues with defaults. MUST stay BEFORE project-corrupt-skip: this dialog's wording also contains 已损坏, and first match wins — both press Enter, but forensics should log the right rule.

name: project-corrupt-skip
comment: Real data reject — '项目文件似乎已损坏（跳过部分：N）(26::0)': builder output has a structural/size bug so AE skips a layer/stream. Press OK so the project opens (with the part dropped) and the JSX catches the missing layer/path → writes .done(FAIL). Previously surfaced as exit 2 (unknown-modal) when OCR was occluded, masking a genuine reject as a flake — see incident-reports/ae2020-shape-ldta-164-corrupt.md + path-keyframe-write-re.md.

name: ae2025-performance-preferences
comment: AE 2025 first-launch Performance Preferences wizard — ESC dismisses without committing, falls back to defaults

name: ae-safe-mode-recovery
comment: AE 'Safe Mode' / Recovery dialog after wrapper force-kill on prior run — ESC declines safe-mode, continues normal launch

name: scripting-write-access-disabled
ocrMatch: 允许脚本写入文件和访问网络
message: AE 的脚本写文件权限未开启 — 打开该 AE 版本的 首选项 > 脚本和表达式 > 勾选「允许脚本写入文件和访问网络」，然后重跑。(Preferences > Scripting & Expressions > Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network)
comment: JSX threw 'Unable to execute script at line N. Permission denied' — the per-version preference is off (fresh AE install / prefs reset). No keystroke fixes this; Abort with exit 7 so the operator enables the pref instead of burning TimeoutSec. First seen 2026-06-11 on AE 2025 after its prefs were recreated.

name: scripting-plugin-unavailable
message: AE 无法执行 JSX，报 Scripting plugin is not installed。先关闭残留 AfterFX 进程并重启 AE；若复现，检查/修复该 AE 安装的脚本插件（Support Files/Plug-ins/Keyframe/Scripting.aex 与 Required/Expressions and Scripting Palette.aex）。
comment: AE shows this before any JSX can run, so no .done file can be written and pressing OK would only hide an environment/launch failure. First observed 2026-06-29 after an interrupted AE ship gate; plugin files existed on disk and Plugin Loading.log listed the scripting palette, so classify as abort-with-forensics rather than a data reject.

name: kbar-evalscript-timeout
comment: The KBar CEP toolbar panel (installed on this machine's AE) runs a watchdog that calls CSInterface.evalScript; when our `AfterFX -r` gate JSX keeps AE's main thread busy (e.g. openInViewer + saveFrameToPng over 10 comps in the text-style render gate), KBar's round-trip exceeds its timeout and it pops an error modal titled literally 'KBar' (#32770) reading 'KBarServer could not ... CSInterface evalScript timed out'. This is NOT a data problem — our -r script keeps running independently; the modal just blocks AE's message pump (which also leaves AE's own '保存项目' save-progress dialog stuck behind it). Press ENTER on the OK button to dismiss; AE then drains the JSX to completion and writes .done. Title-match (Layer B) fires without OCR — fast + occlusion-immune; ocrMatch carries the ASCII anchor as backup. Surfaced 2026-06-16 as exit-2 unknown-modal on the mg_text_style gate (deterministic, both warm-retry attempts). Safe ordering: distinctive title/text collides with no other rule (no crash/convert/corrupt anchors), so placement is non-critical, but kept among the script-popup dismissals. If KBar interferes with more gates, the cleaner durable fix is to remove/disable the KBar CEP extension for the gate AE rather than dismiss its modal each run.

name: script-alert
comment: ExtendScript alert() popup — Enter clicks OK. RE fixture JSX should write .done instead of alert(), but this is the defensive fallback for legacy scripts (see test_data/generators/re_gradient.jsx)

name: executing-script-progress
comment: AE progress dialog shown while a long-running JSX is active. Slow frames can keep it visible beyond the unknown-modal grace; ignore it and keep waiting for the .done marker bounded by TimeoutSec.

name: startup-splash
comment: AE startup splash / About screen (class #32770, empty title, copyright text). On this machine AE 2020/2025 cold-start can linger 30-45s — longer than the unknown-modal grace — so without this it gets force-killed mid-init, which then cascades into a safe-mode dialog next launch (see incidents/ae-automation-occlusion-crashstate.md). action=Ignore: known-benign, do NOT send keys and do NOT escalate to exit-2 — wait it out (bounded by TimeoutSec) until AE finishes loading and the JSX writes .done. OCR-only match (never windowClass) so real #32770 dialogs (convert/corrupt/data-missing/safe-mode) still hit their specific CJK rules; localized error dialogs never contain the English copyright tokens.
